summary:
P3-J/K-R7 Final Compatibility and Integrity Gate Implementation Plan.

Includes:
1. Exact interface transformation (snapshotToWebCephImportResult) for 100% type-safe compatibility with WebCephImportResult.
2. Deterministic Base64 validation algorithm covering MIME whitelist, syntax, padding, and canonical trailing bits.
3. Accurate trace of approved snapshot preservation through handleCommit, onCommitImport, ClinicalMediaWorkspace, and App.tsx persistence.
4. Deterministic test database cleanup policy (cleanup only on PASS, retention on FAIL).
5. Strict distinction between PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, and NOT_RUN persistence status.
